mutants.rationale: Claim that a retraction obeying the old-image law already refuses every off-image point (lax violations 0); the lax retraction obeys the law and refuses none of the 185 off-image points.

Claim one section image at another stage is accepted by r_n; the stage test is exact (15 of 15 per other stage are refused at g = 2).
Claim a three-or-more-glyph body at the right stage is accepted; only bodies of the five shapes are accepted.
Claim s(r(p)) = p for every presentation of the one-glyph universe; it fails on every refused point (37 of 42).
Report stage-mismatch refusals in a universe that has a single stage; there is no other stage to mismatch.
Claim the lax retraction that accepts everything fails the old-image law; it obeys the law exactly, which is why the law cannot be the refusal.
Report one wrong payload (for example a retained pair read back as a simplex cut); accepted_only_from_section fixes the payload as the base presentation, and the universe has none wrong.
Claim a retraction term r_n<..> or the refusal token is accepted by r_n, so more outcomes are accepted than there are section images (16 instead of 15 at g = 2).
Claim two base presentations lift to the same term (image smaller than Base, 14 of 15); the lift is injective.
A toy section with multiplier 0 has no total left inverse y // 0 and is not one of the public cases.
Claim the toy witness (section 2x, retraction y // 2) leaves nothing to refuse; the round trip s(r(y)) = y refuses the 3 odd points of 6.
Claim the identity section (multiplier 1) has an off-image point to refuse; a surjective section has none.
